Cyber strategy
Design cyber risk strategies, aligned to business priorities
Share cybersecurity accountability and build a cybersecurity- first culture to support business transformation and accelerate enterprise growth.
Why cyber strategy matters
Cybersecurity today is not just IT’s concern. Daily, evolving threats can disrupt business operations and cause costly breaches. But, by integrating cybersecurity into your strategy, you can minimize risks and build resilience. It's about protecting your business's future, so let's prioritize cybersecurity and drive growth with confidence.
Data
Toggle accordion
88%
of boards view cybersecurity as a business risk, not just an IT problem
60%
of CEOs say cybersecurity is not baked into their business strategies, services or products from the outset
85%
of CEOs do not have dedicated board meetings about cybersecurity
Grow with confidence
Many CEOs lack confidence in their organizations’ ability to protect against cyberattacks — despite seeing cybersecurity as vital to growth.
What you can do
Defend your organization from deepfakes and reinforce trust and resilience.
As these sophisticated digital manipulations become more prevalent, organizations need to fortify their defenses and effectively shield themselves from deepfake threats. Organizations must act quickly to reinforce trust and resilience. A combination of enhanced security capabilities, robust controls and employee education and awareness is critical.
Learn more
223%
Increase since 2023 in the buying and selling of deepfake-related tools on major dark web forums.
Share cybersecurity accountability
Strengthen the alignment between your board, cybersecurity and business leaders, and establish cyber accountability beyond the CISO.
Rapidly respond to evolving regulations
Adhere to complex laws, regulations and risk tolerances across your organization, in every industry and geography in which you operate.
Build a cybersecurity-first culture to accelerate secure growth
Retain top cybersecurity talent and focus training to build awareness and responsiveness to threats. Prioritize investments that protect areas of high behavioral risk.
Support business transformation
Align cybersecurity with the business to speed your transformation and growth.
Manage cyber risk and compliance as-a-service
Reduce the cost of meeting your risk and compliance requirements when you introduce efficient operational security.
What you’ll achieve
Cyber risk oversight
Embed cybersecurity into your overall business strategy to minimize risk and put cyber-resilience at the heart of your transformation efforts.
Reduced risk
Reduce business disruption and cybersecurity breaches with ongoing regulatory compliance, supply chain visibility and improved contact-center cybersecurity.
Embedded cybersecurity
Everyone is responsible for cybersecurity. Data, analytics and AI insights fuel key cyber metrics to inform decision-making and business health scorecard.
Rapid business growth
Build cybersecurity into your transformation efforts: cost optimization, security operation and effective merger-and-acquisition planning.
Flexible delivery models
Complete regulatory and risk services that improve quality, productivity, talent resources and reduce cost.
